"use strict";
const V = {
  add:(a,b)=>[a[0]+b[0],a[1]+b[1],a[2]+b[2]],
  sub:(a,b)=>[a[0]-b[0],a[1]-b[1],a[2]-b[2]],
  mul:(a,k)=>[a[0]*k,a[1]*k,a[2]*k],
  dot:(a,b)=>a[0]*b[0]+a[1]*b[1]+a[2]*b[2],
  cross:(a,b)=>[a[1]*b[2]-a[2]*b[1],a[2]*b[0]-a[0]*b[2],a[0]*b[1]-a[1]*b[0]],
  len:a=>Math.hypot(...a),
  unit(a){return this.mul(a,1/(Math.hypot(...a)||1));},
  mix:(a,b,t)=>[a[0]+(b[0]-a[0])*t,a[1]+(b[1]-a[1])*t,a[2]+(b[2]-a[2])*t]
};
const UP=[0,1,0], WHITE=[1,1,1], TAU=2*Math.PI;
const clamp=(v,a,b)=>Math.max(a,Math.min(b,v));
function perspective(fovy,aspect,near,far){
  const s=1/Math.tan(fovy/2),d=near-far;
  return new Float32Array([s/aspect,0,0,0,0,s,0,0,0,0,(far+near)/d,-1,0,0,2*near*far/d,0]);
}
function viewMatrix(eye,target){
  const z=V.unit(V.sub(eye,target)), x=V.unit(V.cross(UP,z)), y=V.cross(z,x);
  return new Float32Array([x[0],y[0],z[0],0,x[1],y[1],z[1],0,x[2],y[2],z[2],0,-V.dot(x,eye),-V.dot(y,eye),-V.dot(z,eye),1]);
}
function mmul(a,b){
  const c=new Float32Array(16);
  for(let j=0;j<4;j++)for(let i=0;i<4;i++)c[i+4*j]=a[i]*b[4*j]+a[4+i]*b[4*j+1]+a[8+i]*b[4*j+2]+a[12+i]*b[4*j+3];
  return c;
}
function planes(m){
  const p=[];
  for(let i=0;i<3;i++)for(const s of [-1,1])p.push([m[3]+s*m[i],m[7]+s*m[i+4],m[11]+s*m[i+8],m[15]+s*m[i+12]]);
  return p;
}
function visible(bounds,ps){
  for(const [x,y,z,w] of ps)if(x*bounds[x<0?0:3]+y*bounds[y<0?1:4]+z*bounds[z<0?2:5]+w<0)return false;
  return true;
}
let randomState=0xabc52319;
function rand(a=0,b=1){randomState^=randomState<<13;randomState^=randomState>>>17;randomState^=randomState<<5;return a+(b-a)*(randomState>>>0)/4294967296;}
function hexColor(h){return [(h>>16&255)/255,(h>>8&255)/255,(h&255)/255];}

const mainVS=`#version 300 es
precision highp float;
layout(location=0) in vec3 aPos;
layout(location=1) in vec3 aNormal;
layout(location=2) in vec2 aUV;
layout(location=3) in vec3 aColor;
layout(location=4) in vec4 aFinish;
uniform mat4 uVP;
out vec3 wp;out vec3 wn;out vec2 uv;out vec3 tint;
flat out int layer;out vec3 finish;
void main(){wp=aPos;wn=aNormal;uv=aUV;tint=aColor;layer=int(aFinish.x+.5);finish=aFinish.yzw;gl_Position=uVP*vec4(wp,1.);}
`;
const mainFS=`#version 300 es
precision highp float;precision highp int;precision highp sampler2DArray;precision highp sampler2DArrayShadow;
in vec3 wp;in vec3 wn;in vec2 uv;in vec3 tint;flat in int layer;in vec3 finish;
out vec4 outColor;
uniform sampler2DArray uTiles;
uniform sampler2DArrayShadow uShadows;
uniform mat4 uLights[3];
uniform vec3 uEye;
uniform vec4 uLamp[16];uniform vec4 uColor[16];uniform int uCount;
float shadowTerm(int i,vec3 pos,float nd){
 vec4 s=uLights[i]*vec4(pos,1.0);
 vec3 q=s.xyz/s.w*.5+.5;
 if(s.w<0.0 || any(lessThan(q,vec3(.001)))||any(greaterThan(q,vec3(.999))))return .46;
 float b=.00032+.0013*(1.-nd);
 float k=.0014;
 float val=0.;
 val+=texture(uShadows,vec4(q.xy+vec2(-.75,-.30)*k,float(i),q.z-b));
 val+=texture(uShadows,vec4(q.xy+vec2(.38,-.80)*k,float(i),q.z-b));
 val+=texture(uShadows,vec4(q.xy+vec2(.80,.40)*k,float(i),q.z-b));
 val+=texture(uShadows,vec4(q.xy+vec2(-.35,.81)*k,float(i),q.z-b));
 return .20+.80*val*.25;
}
void main(){
 if(layer==50){
  float a=pow(max(0.,1.-dot(uv*2.-1.,uv*2.-1.)),2.)*finish.z;
  outColor=vec4(.075,.052,.032,a);return;
 }
 if(layer==51){
  float fringe=pow(1.-abs(uv.x*2.-1.),1.7);
  outColor=vec4(tint,fringe*(1.-uv.y)*(1.-uv.y)*finish.z);return;
 }
 vec4 texel=texture(uTiles,vec3(uv,float(min(layer,31))));
 vec3 n=normalize(wn), v=normalize(uEye-wp);
 if(!gl_FrontFacing)n=-n;
 vec3 dp1=dFdx(wp),dp2=dFdy(wp);
 vec3 r1=cross(dp2,n),r2=cross(n,dp1);
 float det=dot(dp1,r1);
 float relief=layer==0||layer==1||layer==14?.019:(layer==2||layer==3||layer==9?.010:.004);
 vec3 grad=(dFdx(texel.a)*r1+dFdy(texel.a)*r2)*sign(det)/max(abs(det),.0000001);
 n=normalize(n-clamp(grad*relief,vec3(-.40),vec3(.40)));
 vec3 albedo=pow(clamp(texel.rgb*tint,0.,1.5),vec3(2.2));
 float home=smoothstep(2.25,3.0,wp.z);
 float roost=1.-smoothstep(-5.85,-4.9,wp.z);
 float hemi=clamp(.45+.55*n.y,0.,1.);
 vec3 ambient=mix(vec3(.18,.145,.108),vec3(.42,.43,.39),hemi);
 ambient+=home*vec3(.11,.12,.115);
 ambient+=roost*mix(vec3(.145,.083,.048),vec3(.13,.145,.15),hemi);
 float nearWall=roost*max(smoothstep(6.2,8.35,abs(wp.x)),smoothstep(17.6,20.,-wp.z));
 float foot=smoothstep(-.1,1.95,wp.y);
 ambient*=.78+.22*foot-.16*nearWall*(1.-foot);
 vec3 illumination=ambient*finish.x;
 vec3 shine=vec3(0.);
 float metal=layer==5?.71:layer==6?.74:layer==12?.4:layer==11?.15:.022;
 float gloss=layer==12?44.:layer==5||layer==6?25.:15.;
 vec3 zoneWeight=vec3(smoothstep(1.55,2.80,wp.z),smoothstep(-6.65,-5.05,wp.z)*(1.-smoothstep(2.70,3.95,wp.z)),1.-smoothstep(-5.60,-4.15,wp.z));
 for(int i=0;i<16;i++){
  if(i>=uCount)break;
  float zn=uColor[i].w;
  float zone=zn<.5?zoneWeight.x:(zn<1.5?zoneWeight.y:zoneWeight.z);
  if(zone<.001)continue;
  vec3 toLight=uLamp[i].xyz-wp;float d2=dot(toLight,toLight);
  float fall=max(1.-d2/(uLamp[i].w*uLamp[i].w),0.);
  if(fall<=0.)continue;
  vec3 l=toLight*inversesqrt(max(d2,.00001));
  float nd=max(0.,dot(l,n));
  float att=fall*fall/(1.+d2*.19)*zone;
  float sh=i<3&&nd>.012?shadowTerm(i,wp,nd):1.;
  vec3 radiance=uColor[i].rgb*att;
  illumination+=radiance*(nd*sh*mix(.72,1.,finish.x)+.075*finish.x);
  shine+=radiance*sh*pow(max(dot(n,normalize(l+v)),0.),gloss)*metal*.23;
 }
 vec3 lin=albedo*illumination+shine*finish.x;
 lin+=albedo*finish.y;
 vec3 colour=clamp((lin*(2.51*lin+.03))/(lin*(2.43*lin+.59)+.14),0.,1.);
 colour=pow(colour,vec3(1./2.2));
 float distanceToEye=length(uEye-wp);
 float mist=(1.-exp(-distanceToEye*distanceToEye*.00058))*roost;
 colour=mix(colour,vec3(.47,.365,.273),mist*.56);
 if(roost>.02){
  vec3 segment=wp-uEye;
  vec3 centre=vec3(7.05,1.46,-13.05);
  float t=clamp(dot(centre-uEye,segment)/max(dot(segment,segment),.0001),0.,1.);
  vec3 delta=(uEye+t*segment-centre)*vec3(.92,1.13,.76);
  float warmth=exp(-dot(delta,delta)*.52)*.076*roost;
  colour=mix(colour,vec3(1.,.624,.296),warmth);
 }
 outColor=vec4(colour,finish.z);
}`;
const depthVS=`#version 300 es
layout(location=0) in vec3 aPos;layout(location=4) in vec4 aFinish;
uniform mat4 uVP;void main(){gl_Position=uVP*vec4(aPos,1.);if(aFinish.z>1.)gl_Position=vec4(2.,2.,2.,1.);}`;
const depthFS=`#version 300 es
precision mediump float;void main(){}`;
// First three lights have stationary, precomputed depth maps.
const lightSources=[
 {p:[-4.50,3.04,6.65],target:[1.4,.63,5.85],fov:111,r:12,c:[11.5,11.8,10.2],zone:0},
 {p:[7.89,1.65,-13.00],target:[.0,1.45,-12.7],fov:119,r:19,c:[27.0,10.9,3.50],zone:2},
 {p:[-1.3,7.35,-19.25],target:[.4,1.0,-10.5],fov:116,r:26,c:[24.0,22.3,17.0],zone:2}
];
function lamp(p,r,c,zone){lightSources.push({p,r,c,zone});}
function createProgram(gl,v,f){
 function compile(type,src){
  const s=gl.createShader(type);gl.shaderSource(s,src);gl.compileShader(s);
  if(!gl.getShaderParameter(s,gl.COMPILE_STATUS))throw Error(gl.getShaderInfoLog(s));
  return s;
 }
 const vs=compile(gl.VERTEX_SHADER,v),fs=compile(gl.FRAGMENT_SHADER,f),p=gl.createProgram();
 gl.attachShader(p,vs);gl.attachShader(p,fs);gl.linkProgram(p);gl.deleteShader(vs);gl.deleteShader(fs);
 if(!gl.getProgramParameter(p,gl.LINK_STATUS))throw Error(gl.getProgramInfoLog(p));
 return p;
}
function openingPlanes(eye,z,half,high){
 const pts=[[.56-half,-.16,z],[.56+half,-.16,z],[.56+half,high,z],[.56-half,high,z]],center=[.56,high*.49,z];
 return pts.map((p,i)=>{
  let n=V.cross(V.sub(p,eye),V.sub(pts[(i+1)%4],eye));
  if(V.dot(n,V.sub(center,eye))<0)n=V.mul(n,-1);
  return [...n,-V.dot(n,eye)];
 });
}
function renderer(canvas,gl,groups,tiles,packed){
 const main=createProgram(gl,mainVS,mainFS),depth=createProgram(gl,depthVS,depthFS);
 const loc=(p,s)=>gl.getUniformLocation(p,s);
 const drawLoc=loc(main,"uVP"),eyeLoc=loc(main,"uEye"),shadowLoc=loc(depth,"uVP");
 // All static geometry shares one VAO, index buffer, and texture array.
 let vs,idx,ranges;
 if(packed){vs=packed.v;idx=packed.i;ranges=packed.ranges;}
 else{
  let nv=0,ni=0;for(const g of groups){nv+=g.v.length;ni+=g.i.length;}
  vs=new Float32Array(nv);idx=new Uint32Array(ni);ranges=[];let vi=0,ii=0;
  for(const g of groups){
   vs.set(g.v,vi);const base=vi/15;for(let j=0;j<g.i.length;j++)idx[ii+j]=g.i[j]+base;
   ranges.push({name:g.name,start:ii*4,count:g.i.length,bounds:g.bounds,alpha:g.alpha});
   vi+=g.v.length;ii+=g.i.length;g.v.length=0;g.i.length=0;
  }
 }
 const vao=gl.createVertexArray();gl.bindVertexArray(vao);
 const vb=gl.createBuffer();gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER,vb);gl.bufferData(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER,vs,gl.STATIC_DRAW);
 const ib=gl.createBuffer();gl.bindBuffer(gl.ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER,ib);gl.bufferData(gl.ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER,idx,gl.STATIC_DRAW);
 const format=packed?[[3,gl.FLOAT,false,0],[3,gl.SHORT,true,12],[2,gl.HALF_FLOAT,false,18],[3,gl.HALF_FLOAT,false,22],[4,gl.HALF_FLOAT,false,28]]:[[3,gl.FLOAT,false,0],[3,gl.FLOAT,false,12],[2,gl.FLOAT,false,24],[3,gl.FLOAT,false,32],[4,gl.FLOAT,false,44]];
 format.forEach(([n,type,normalized,offset],i)=>{gl.enableVertexAttribArray(i);gl.vertexAttribPointer(i,n,type,normalized,packed?36:60,offset);});
 const sm=gl.createTexture();gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE1);gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D_ARRAY,sm);
 const size=1024;gl.texStorage3D(gl.TEXTURE_2D_ARRAY,1,gl.DEPTH_COMPONENT24,size,size,3);
 for(const pname of [gl.TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER,gl.TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER])gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D_ARRAY,pname,gl.LINEAR);
 for(const pname of [gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_S,gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_T])gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D_ARRAY,pname,gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE);
 gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D_ARRAY,gl.TEXTURE_COMPARE_MODE,gl.COMPARE_REF_TO_TEXTURE);
 gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D_ARRAY,gl.TEXTURE_COMPARE_FUNC,gl.LEQUAL);
 const fb=gl.createFramebuffer();gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER,fb);gl.drawBuffers([gl.NONE]);gl.readBuffer(gl.NONE);
 gl.enable(gl.DEPTH_TEST);gl.depthFunc(gl.LEQUAL);gl.disable(gl.CULL_FACE);gl.viewport(0,0,size,size);gl.useProgram(depth);
 const lightMats=[];gl.enable(gl.POLYGON_OFFSET_FILL);gl.polygonOffset(1.4,1.6);
 for(let j=0;j<3;j++){
   const s=lightSources[j],m=mmul(perspective(s.fov*Math.PI/180,1,.16,38),viewMatrix(s.p,s.target));lightMats.push(...m);
   gl.framebufferTextureLayer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER,gl.DEPTH_ATTACHMENT,sm,0,j);
   if(gl.checkFramebufferStatus(gl.FRAMEBUFFER)!==gl.FRAMEBUFFER_COMPLETE)throw Error("Unable to initialize a WebGL 2 depth attachment.");
   gl.clear(gl.DEPTH_BUFFER_BIT);gl.uniformMatrix4fv(shadowLoc,false,m);const fr=planes(m);
   for(const r of ranges)if(!r.alpha&&visible(r.bounds,fr))gl.drawElements(gl.TRIANGLES,r.count,gl.UNSIGNED_INT,r.start);
 }
 gl.disable(gl.POLYGON_OFFSET_FILL);gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER,null);gl.deleteFramebuffer(fb);gl.useProgram(main);
 gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE0);gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D_ARRAY,tiles);
 gl.uniform1i(loc(main,"uTiles"),0);gl.uniform1i(loc(main,"uShadows"),1);gl.uniformMatrix4fv(loc(main,"uLights[0]"),false,new Float32Array(lightMats));
 const ls=lightSources.slice(0,16);gl.uniform1i(loc(main,"uCount"),ls.length);
 gl.uniform4fv(loc(main,"uLamp[0]"),new Float32Array(ls.flatMap(s=>[...s.p,s.r])));
 gl.uniform4fv(loc(main,"uColor[0]"),new Float32Array(ls.flatMap(s=>[...s.c,s.zone])));
 gl.clearColor(.23,.205,.17,1);gl.blendFunc(gl.SRC_ALPHA,gl.ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA);
 return function draw(eye,forward){
  const scale=Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio||1,1.5,Math.sqrt(2400000/(Math.max(1,canvas.clientWidth*canvas.clientHeight))));
  const w=Math.max(1,Math.round(canvas.clientWidth*scale)),h=Math.max(1,Math.round(canvas.clientHeight*scale));
  if(canvas.width!==w||canvas.height!==h){canvas.width=w;canvas.height=h;}
  gl.viewport(0,0,w,h);gl.clear(gl.COLOR_BUFFER_BIT|gl.DEPTH_BUFFER_BIT);
  const vp=mmul(perspective(66*Math.PI/180,w/h,.055,65),viewMatrix(eye,V.add(eye,forward)));
  const fr=planes(vp);gl.uniformMatrix4fv(drawLoc,false,vp);gl.uniform3fv(eyeLoc,eye);
  const gates=[];
  for(const [z,half,high] of [[2.70,1.06,2.55],[-5.34,1.21,2.91]]){
   if(Math.abs(eye[2]-z)>.65)gates.push({z,forward:eye[2]>z,planes:openingPlanes(eye,z,half,high)});
  }
  const pass=r=>visible(r.bounds,fr)&&gates.every(g=>{
   const beyond=g.forward?r.bounds[5]<g.z-.47:r.bounds[2]>g.z+.47;
   return !beyond||visible(r.bounds,g.planes);
  });
  for(const r of ranges)if(!r.alpha&&pass(r))gl.drawElements(gl.TRIANGLES,r.count,gl.UNSIGNED_INT,r.start);
  gl.enable(gl.BLEND);gl.depthMask(false);
  for(const r of ranges)if(r.alpha&&pass(r))gl.drawElements(gl.TRIANGLES,r.count,gl.UNSIGNED_INT,r.start);
  gl.depthMask(true);gl.disable(gl.BLEND);
 };
}

"use strict";
const groupsByName=new Map();
let part="quarters",tr={x:0,y:0,z:0,c:1,s:0};
function group(name){part=name;}
function frame(x,y,z,yaw,fn){
 const before=tr,c=Math.cos(yaw),s=Math.sin(yaw);
 tr={x:before.x+before.c*x+before.s*z,y:before.y+y,z:before.z-before.s*x+before.c*z,c:before.c*c-before.s*s,s:before.s*c+before.c*s};
 try{fn();}finally{tr=before;}
}
function point(a){return [tr.x+tr.c*a[0]+tr.s*a[2],tr.y+a[1],tr.z-tr.s*a[0]+tr.c*a[2]];}
function direction(a){return [tr.c*a[0]+tr.s*a[2],a[1],-tr.s*a[0]+tr.c*a[2]];}
function mat(id,tint=WHITE,ao=1,emit=0,alpha=1){return {id,tint:typeof tint==="number"?hexColor(tint):tint,ao,emit,alpha};}
function shade(m,k,ao=1){return {...m,tint:V.mul(m.tint,k),ao:m.ao*ao};}
function getBatch(m){
 const alpha=m.alpha<1,key=part+(alpha?"-translucent":"");
 let g=groupsByName.get(key);
 if(!g){g={name:key,v:[],i:[],bounds:[Infinity,Infinity,Infinity,-Infinity,-Infinity,-Infinity],alpha};groupsByName.set(key,g);}
 return g;
}
function face(pts,m,texcoords,normals){
 const g=getBatch(m),i0=g.v.length/15;
 const groundNormal=V.unit(V.cross(V.sub(pts[1],pts[0]),V.sub(pts[2],pts[0])));
 const flat=direction(groundNormal);
 for(let i=0;i<pts.length;i++){
   const p=point(pts[i]),n=normals?direction(normals[i]):flat;
   const uv=texcoords?texcoords[i]:[(Math.abs(groundNormal[0])>.72?pts[i][2]:pts[i][0])*.9,(Math.abs(groundNormal[1])>.72?pts[i][2]:pts[i][1])*.9];
   g.v.push(...p,...n,...uv,...m.tint,m.id,m.ao,m.emit,m.alpha);
   for(let j=0;j<3;j++){g.bounds[j]=Math.min(g.bounds[j],p[j]);g.bounds[j+3]=Math.max(g.bounds[j+3],p[j]);}
 }
 for(let i=1;i<pts.length-1;i++)g.i.push(i0,i0+i,i0+i+1);
}
const AX=[[1,0,0],[0,1,0],[0,0,1]];
const scaleTile=[1.05,.96,1.38,1.1,.72,.71,.58,.5,.74,.86,1.23,.65,.57,.5,1.65,1.37];
function block(center,axes,size,m,bevel=0){
 const half=size.map(q=>q*.5),be=Math.min(bevel,...half.map(q=>q*.72));
 const major=size.indexOf(Math.max(...size));
 const ox=center[0]*.338+center[1]*.27,oy=center[2]*.249+center[1]*.33;
 const convert=p=>[center[0]+axes[0][0]*p[0]+axes[1][0]*p[1]+axes[2][0]*p[2],center[1]+axes[0][1]*p[0]+axes[1][1]*p[1]+axes[2][1]*p[2],center[2]+axes[0][2]*p[0]+axes[1][2]*p[1]+axes[2][2]*p[2]];
 function plane(verts,n){
  if(V.dot(V.cross(V.sub(verts[1],verts[0]),V.sub(verts[2],verts[0])),n)<0)verts.reverse();
  const a=n.map(Math.abs),axis=a.indexOf(Math.max(...a)),u=(axis+1)%3,v=(axis+2)%3;
  const mm=Array.isArray(m)?m[axis]:m,grain=(mm.id===2||mm.id===3),end=grain&&axis===major&&size[major]>Math.min(...size)*1.8;
  const mm2=end?{...mm,id:4}:mm,sz=scaleTile[mm2.id]||1;
  const flip=grain?size[v]>size[u]:u===1;
  face(verts.map(convert),mm2,verts.map(p=>[p[flip?v:u]/sz+ox,p[flip?u:v]/sz+oy]));
 }
 for(let i=0;i<3;i++)for(const sign of [-1,1]){
  const a=(i+1)%3,b=(i+2)%3,n=[0,0,0];n[i]=sign;
  plane([[-1,-1],[1,-1],[1,1],[-1,1]].map(([s,t])=>{const p=[0,0,0];p[i]=sign*half[i];p[a]=s*(half[a]-be);p[b]=t*(half[b]-be);return p;}),n);
 }
 if(be<=0)return;
 for(let i=0;i<3;i++){
  const a=(i+1)%3,b=(i+2)%3;
  for(const s of [-1,1])for(const t of [-1,1]){
   const n=[0,0,0];n[a]=s;n[b]=t;
   plane([[-1,0],[1,0],[1,1],[-1,1]].map(([end,side])=>{const p=[0,0,0];p[i]=end*(half[i]-be);p[a]=s*(half[a]-side*be);p[b]=t*(half[b]-(1-side)*be);return p;}),n);
  }
 }
 for(const sx of [-1,1])for(const sy of [-1,1])for(const sz of [-1,1]){
   const sig=[sx,sy,sz];plane([0,1,2].map(i=>sig.map((s,j)=>s*(half[j]-(j===i?0:be)))),sig);
 }
}
function box(x,y,z,w,h,d,m,bevel=0,yaw=0){
 const c=Math.cos(yaw),s=Math.sin(yaw);
 block([x,y,z],[[c,0,-s],UP,[s,0,c]],[w,h,d],m,bevel);
}
function beam(a,b,w,d,m,bevel=.012,twist=0){
 const axis=V.unit(V.sub(b,a)),ref=Math.abs(axis[1])>.97?[0,0,1]:UP;
 let u=V.unit(V.cross(axis,ref)),v=V.unit(V.cross(u,axis));
 if(twist){const p=u;u=V.add(V.mul(u,Math.cos(twist)),V.mul(v,Math.sin(twist)));v=V.cross(u,axis);}
 block(V.mix(a,b,.5),[u,axis,v],[w,V.len(V.sub(b,a)),d],m,bevel);
}
function lathe(x,y,z,profile,m,segments=16){
 for(let j=0;j<profile.length-1;j++){
  const [r0,y0]=profile[j],[r1,y1]=profile[j+1],mm=Array.isArray(m)?m[j%m.length]:m;
  const sl=y1-y0,sr=r0-r1,bias=(scaleTile[mm.id]||1);
  for(let i=0;i<segments;i++){
   const a=i*TAU/segments,b=(i+1)*TAU/segments,ca=Math.cos(a),sa=Math.sin(a),cb=Math.cos(b),sb=Math.sin(b);
   const v0=[x+r0*ca,y+y0,z+r0*sa],v1=[x+r1*ca,y+y1,z+r1*sa],v2=[x+r1*cb,y+y1,z+r1*sb],v3=[x+r0*cb,y+y0,z+r0*sb];
   const na=V.unit([sl*ca,sr,sl*sa]),nb=V.unit([sl*cb,sr,sl*sb]);
   const u0=i/segments*Math.max(.5,Math.max(r0,r1)*TAU)/bias,u1=(i+1)/segments*Math.max(.5,Math.max(r0,r1)*TAU)/bias;
   if(r0===0)face([v0,v1,v2],mm,[[u0,y0/bias],[u0,y1/bias],[u1,y1/bias]],[na,na,nb]);
   else if(r1===0)face([v0,v2,v3],mm,[[u0,y0/bias],[u1,y1/bias],[u1,y0/bias]],[na,nb,nb]);
   else face([v0,v1,v2,v3],mm,[[u0,y0/bias],[u0,y1/bias],[u1,y1/bias],[u1,y0/bias]],[na,na,nb,nb]);
  }
 }
}
function cylinder(a,b,r0,r1,m,n=12,cap=true){
 const axis=V.unit(V.sub(b,a)),u=V.unit(V.cross(Math.abs(axis[1])>.94?[0,0,1]:UP,axis)),v=V.cross(axis,u);
 const A=[],B=[],N=[],len=V.len(V.sub(b,a)),slope=(r0-r1)/Math.max(.001,len),sz=scaleTile[m.id]||1;
 for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const t=TAU*i/n,nm=V.add(V.mul(u,Math.cos(t)),V.mul(v,Math.sin(t)));A.push(V.add(a,V.mul(nm,r0)));B.push(V.add(b,V.mul(nm,r1)));N.push(V.unit(V.add(nm,V.mul(axis,slope))));}
 for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const k=(i+1)%n,h=Math.max(r0,r1)*TAU/n/sz;
  face([A[i],A[k],B[k],B[i]],m,[[0,i*h],[0,(i+1)*h],[len/sz,(i+1)*h],[len/sz,i*h]],[N[i],N[k],N[k],N[i]]);
 }
 if(cap){
   face([...A].reverse(),m);face(B,m);
 }
}
function ellipsoid(x,y,z,rx,ry,rz,m,n=16,rings=8,yaw=0){
 const c=Math.cos(yaw),s=Math.sin(yaw);
 const pt=(i,j)=>{const a=TAU*i/n,b=Math.PI*(j/rings-.5),cb=Math.cos(b),px=Math.cos(a)*cb,py=Math.sin(b),pz=Math.sin(a)*cb;
  const nx=px/rx,ny=py/ry,nz=pz/rz;
  return [[x+c*rx*px+s*rz*pz,y+ry*py,z-s*rx*px+c*rz*pz],V.unit([c*nx+s*nz,ny,-s*nx+c*nz]),[i/n*rx*5,j/rings*rz*2.6]];};
 for(let j=0;j<rings;j++)for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
  const q=[pt(i,j),pt(i,j+1),pt(i+1,j+1),pt(i+1,j)];
  if(j===0)q.pop();if(j===rings-1)q.splice(2,1);
  face(q.map(t=>t[0]),m,q.map(t=>t[2]),q.map(t=>t[1]));
 }
}
function pipe(pts,r,m,n=7,closed=false){
 if(pts.length<2)return;
 const loops=[],norm=[];let previous=null;
 for(let i=0;i<pts.length;i++){
  const before=pts[i===0?(closed?pts.length-1:0):i-1],after=pts[i===pts.length-1?(closed?0:i):i+1];
  const t=V.unit(V.sub(after,before));
  let u=previous?V.sub(previous,V.mul(t,V.dot(previous,t))):V.cross(Math.abs(t[1])>.90?[0,0,1]:UP,t);
  u=V.unit(u);const v=V.cross(t,u);previous=u;
  const ring=[],ns=[];
  for(let j=0;j<n;j++){const k=TAU*j/n,nm=V.add(V.mul(u,Math.cos(k)),V.mul(v,Math.sin(k)));ring.push(V.add(pts[i],V.mul(nm,r)));ns.push(nm);}
  loops.push(ring);norm.push(ns);
 }
 let length=0;
 for(let i=0;i<pts.length-(closed?0:1);i++){
  const k=(i+1)%pts.length,nl=length+V.len(V.sub(pts[k],pts[i]));
  for(let j=0;j<n;j++){const h=(j+1)%n;face([loops[i][j],loops[i][h],loops[k][h],loops[k][j]],m,[[length,j/n],[length,(j+1)/n],[nl,(j+1)/n],[nl,j/n]],[norm[i][j],norm[i][h],norm[k][h],norm[k][j]]);}
  length=nl;
 }
}
function hoop(c,u,v,r,m,n=24,sides=7){
 const p=[];for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const a=i*TAU/n;p.push(V.add(c,V.add(V.mul(u,Math.cos(a)),V.mul(v,Math.sin(a)))));}
 pipe(p,r,m,sides,true);
}
function chain(a,b,link,wire,m){
 const d=V.sub(b,a),dist=V.len(d),axis=V.unit(d);
 const across=V.unit(V.cross(Math.abs(axis[1])>.92?[0,0,1]:UP,axis));const perp=V.cross(axis,across);
 const n=Math.max(1,Math.round(dist/(1.51*link)));
 for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const w=i%2?V.add(V.mul(across,.26),V.mul(perp,.966)):across;
   hoop(V.mix(a,b,(i+.5)/n),V.mul(w,.60*link),V.mul(axis,link),wire,m,12,5);}
}
function panel(c,right,up,w,h,m){
 const u=V.mul(right,w/2),v=V.mul(up,h/2);
 face([V.sub(V.sub(c,u),v),V.sub(V.add(c,u),v),V.add(V.add(c,u),v),V.add(V.sub(c,u),v)],m,[[0,1],[1,1],[1,0],[0,0]]);
}
function shadow(x,z,w,d,opacity=.32,y=.017){
 face([[x-w/2,y,z+d/2],[x+w/2,y,z+d/2],[x+w/2,y,z-d/2],[x-w/2,y,z-d/2]],mat(50,WHITE,1,0,opacity),[[0,0],[1,0],[1,1],[0,1]]);
}
// Convex prism between matching polygonal ends. Input face order is arbitrary.
function prism(front,back,m){
 const center=V.mul([...front,...back].reduce((a,p)=>V.add(a,p),[0,0,0]),1/(front.length*2));
 function side(p){if(V.dot(V.cross(V.sub(p[1],p[0]),V.sub(p[2],p[0])),V.sub(p[0],center))<0)p.reverse();face(p,m);}
 side([...front]);side([...back]);for(let i=0;i<front.length;i++){const j=(i+1)%front.length;side([front[i],front[j],back[j],back[i]]);}
}

}

async function materialAtlas(gl){
 const image=new Image();const ready=new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{image.onload=resolve;image.onerror=()=>reject(Error("The local material atlas could not be decoded."));});image.src=TILE_SOURCE;await ready;
 const n=384,layers=30,levels=1+Math.floor(Math.log2(n));
 const tex=gl.createTexture();gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE0);gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D_ARRAY,tex);
 gl.texStorage3D(gl.TEXTURE_2D_ARRAY,levels,gl.RGBA8,n,n,layers);gl.pixelStorei(gl.UNPACK_PREMULTIPLY_ALPHA_WEBGL,false);
 const cv=document.createElement("canvas");cv.width=cv.height=n;const c=cv.getContext("2d",{willReadFrequently:true});
 for(let k=0;k<16;k++){
  c.clearRect(0,0,n,n);c.drawImage(image,(k%4)*n,Math.floor(k/4)*n,n,n,0,0,n,n);
  const data=c.getImageData(0,0,n,n).data;
  gl.texSubImage3D(gl.TEXTURE_2D_ARRAY,0,0,0,k,n,n,1,gl.RGBA,gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE,data);
 }
 for(let k=16;k<layers;k++)gl.texSubImage3D(gl.TEXTURE_2D_ARRAY,0,0,0,k,n,n,1,gl.RGBA,gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE,artLayer(k));
 gl.generateMipmap(gl.TEXTURE_2D_ARRAY);
 gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D_ARRAY,gl.TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER,gl.LINEAR_MIPMAP_LINEAR);gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D_ARRAY,gl.TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER,gl.LINEAR);
 const an=gl.getExtension("EXT_texture_filter_anisotropic");if(an)gl.texParameterf(gl.TEXTURE_2D_ARRAY,an.TEXTURE_MAX_ANISOTROPY_EXT,Math.min(4,gl.getParameter(an.MAX_TEXTURE_MAX_ANISOTROPY_EXT)));
 return tex;
}

function roughBlock(x0,x1,y0,y1,z,m,j=.018){
 // The wall core carries the depth. Each individual face has a pitched edge and chipped corners.
 const b=Math.min(j,(x1-x0)*.16,(y1-y0)*.16),c=b*rand(.8,1.8),zz=z+rand(.0008,.007);
 const back=[[x0+c,y0,z],[x1-c,y0,z],[x1,y0+c,z],[x1,y1-c,z],[x1-c,y1,z],[x0+c,y1,z],[x0,y1-c,z],[x0,y0+c,z]];
 const midX=(x0+x1)/2,midY=(y0+y1)/2;
 const front=back.map(([x,y])=>[x+(midX-x)*b/Math.max(.01,(x1-x0)/2),y+(midY-y)*b/Math.max(.01,(y1-y0)/2),zz+b*rand(.81,1.15)]);
 const dx=rand(0,5),dy=rand(0,4),uv=p=>[p[0]*.97+dx,p[1]*.97+dy];

function intervals(a,b,holes,y0,y1){
 let out=[[a,b]];
 for(const hole of holes){
  if(y1<=hole.lo+.0001||y0>=hole.s+hole.h-.0001)continue;
  const v=Math.max(0,(y0-hole.s)/Math.max(.001,hole.h));
  const radius=hole.r*Math.sqrt(Math.max(0,1-v*v));
  const l=hole.x-radius,r=hole.x+radius,next=[];
  for(const [lo,hi] of out){if(l>=hi||r<=lo)next.push([lo,hi]);else{if(l>lo)next.push([lo,l]);if(r<hi)next.push([r,hi]);}}
  out=next;
 }
 return out;
}
function wallFace(a,b,base,top,z,opts={}){
 const {holes=[],m=STONE,course=.34,width=.7,depth=.28,plaster=false,soot=false}=opts;
 let yy=base,row=0;const cuts=[base,top,...holes.flatMap(o=>[o.lo,o.s,o.s+o.h])].filter(q=>q>=base&&q<=top).sort((p,q)=>p-q);
 while(yy<top-.001){
  let yn=Math.min(top,yy+course*(plaster?1:rand(.91,1.09)));
  for(const v of cuts)if(v>yy+.001&&v<yn-.001)yn=v;
  for(const [l,r] of intervals(a,b,holes,yy,yn)){
   if(r-l<.008)continue;
   box((l+r)*.5,(yy+yn)*.5,z-depth*.5,r-l,yn-yy,depth,plaster?m:MORTAR);
   if(!plaster){
    let x=l,n=0;
    while(x<r-.005){
     let w=width*rand(.68,1.33)*(n===0&&row%2?.58:1);
     if(r-x-w<width*.34)w=r-x;else w=Math.min(w,r-x);
     const dark=soot?1-.20*Math.max(0,(yy-2.5)/6)-.08*Math.max(0,1-yy/1.7):1;
     const mm=shade(m,rand(.86,1.09)*dark);
     if(w>.035&&yn-yy>.035)roughBlock(x+.007,x+w-.007,yy+.007,yn-.007,z+.002,mm,course*.060);
     x+=w;n++;
    }
   }
  }
  yy=yn;row++;
 }
}

function surface(nu,nv,fn,uvfn,m){
 const samples=[];

function bandPath(pts,width,m,stitch=true,closed=false){
 // Form a thick leather ribbon in the wall plane, preserving the broad face and finished edges.
 const edge1=[],edge2=[],back1=[],back2=[],n=pts.length,t=.012;
 for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
  const a=pts[i===0?(closed?n-1:0):i-1],b=pts[i===n-1?(closed?0:i):i+1],d=V.sub(b,a),len=Math.hypot(d[0],d[1])||1;
  const u=[-d[1]/len*width/2,d[0]/len*width/2,0],v=pts[i];
  edge1.push(V.add(v,u));edge2.push(V.sub(v,u));back1.push(V.add(edge1[i],[0,0,-t]));back2.push(V.add(edge2[i],[0,0,-t]));
 }
 let length=0;
 for(let i=0;i<n-(closed?0:1);i++){
  const j=(i+1)%n,step=V.len(V.sub(pts[j],pts[i]));
  face([edge1[i],edge2[i],edge2[j],edge1[j]],m,[[length*2,0],[length*2,width*3],[(length+step)*2,width*3],[(length+step)*2,0]]);
  face([back1[i],back1[j],back2[j],back2[i]],shade(m,.75));face([edge1[i],edge1[j],back1[j],back1[i]],shade(m,.61));face([edge2[j],edge2[i],back2[i],back2[j]],shade(m,.64));
  if(stitch&&i%2===0){
   for(const side of [edge1,edge2]){
    let p=V.mix(pts[i],side[i],.77),q=V.mix(pts[j],side[j],.77);p[2]+=.0025;q[2]+=.0025;
    const v=V.sub(q,p),w=.0028,unit=V.unit([-v[1],v[0],0]),a=V.mix(p,q,.2),b=V.mix(p,q,.79);

   }
  }
  length+=step;
 }
}

function clawSet(x,z,length,yaw=0,count=4,spacing=.17){

function makeNest(){
 const cx=.36,cz=-15.71,rx=4.22,rz=1.85,deck=1.720;
 const top=(a,r)=>{
   const shape=1+.040*Math.sin(3*a+.4)+.027*Math.sin(6*a-.7);
   const lip=Math.exp(-Math.pow((r-.82)/.205,2));
   const x=cx+rx*r*shape*Math.cos(a),z=cz+rz*r*(1+.060*Math.sin(3*a-.4))*Math.sin(a);
   const y=deck+.095+.038*Math.sin(a*3+1)*r+.46*lip*(.80+.17*Math.sin(a-.40)+.16*Math.sin(4*a))+.030*Math.sin(a*11+r*6)*r;
   return [x,y,z];
 };
 const uv=p=>[p[0]/.92,p[2]/.92];
 const slices=72,layers=10;
 for(let j=0;j<layers;j++)for(let i=0;i<slices;i++){
   const a=i*TAU/slices,b=(i+1)*TAU/slices,r=j/layers,s=(j+1)/layers;
   let pts=j?[top(a,r),top(b,r),top(b,s),top(a,s)]:[top(a,0),top(b,s),top(a,s)];
   const m=shade(STRAW,.84+.16*r+.024*Math.sin(a*4));
   face(pts,m,pts.map(uv));
 }
 for(let i=0;i<slices;i++){
   const a=i*TAU/slices,b=(i+1)*TAU/slices,A=top(a,1),B=top(b,1);
   face([A,B,[B[0]*.996,deck+.018,B[2]],[A[0]*.996,deck+.018,A[2]]],shade(STRAW,.78));
 }
 // Loose cut straw follows the coil of the bed. Opaque bent ribbons batch with the bed.
 for(let k=0;k<1850;k++){
   const a=rand(0,TAU),r=k<1420?rand(.60,1.019):Math.sqrt(rand(.02,.76)),q=top(a,r),d=rand(.067,.32),dir=a+Math.PI/2+rand(-.82,.82);
   const dx=Math.cos(dir),dz=Math.sin(dir),ww=rand(.0027,.0068),ex=dx*d*.50,ez=dz*d*.50;
   const p=[q[0]-ex,q[1]+.019,q[2]-ez],n=[q[0]+dx*.02,q[1]+rand(.026,.072),q[2]+dz*.04],e=[q[0]+ex,q[1]+rand(.003,.051),q[2]+ez];
   const m=mat(7,[rand(.70,1.01),rand(.585,.84),rand(.34,.59)]),u=[-dz*ww,ww*.42,dx*ww];
   face([p,V.add(n,u),e,V.sub(n,u)],m);
   if(k%6===0){const s=V.mix(n,e,.40);pipe([s,e],.0033,m,4);}
 }
}

function walkable(x,z,r=PLAYER_RADIUS){
 if(!Number.isFinite(x+z)||z>9.282-r||z< -19.965+r)return false;
 const portal=(center,half)=>Math.abs(x-center)<half-r;
 if(z>2.76-.26-r && z<2.77+.22+r && !portal(.56,.864))return false;
 if(z> -5.51-.27-r && z< -5.19+.23+r && !portal(.56,.988))return false;
 if(z>=2.70){if(x< -3.459+r||x>3.459-r)return false;}
 else if(z>=-5.34){if(x< -1.687+r||x>2.827-r)return false;}
 else if(x< -8.384+r||x>8.384-r)return false;
 for(const o of obstacles){
  const dx=x-o.x,dz=z-o.z,lx=o.c*dx-o.s*dz,lz=o.s*dx+o.c*dz;
  const ax=Math.max(0,Math.abs(lx)-o.hx),az=Math.max(0,Math.abs(lz)-o.hz);
  if(ax*ax+az*az<r*r)return false;
 }
 return true;
}
function slide(body,dx,dz){
 const steps=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(Math.max(Math.abs(dx),Math.abs(dz))/.075));
 for(let j=0;j<steps;j++){const x=body.x+dx/steps,z=body.z+dz/steps;
  if(walkable(x,body.z))body.x=x;if(walkable(body.x,z))body.z=z;
 }
}

async function readPackedScene(){
 if(typeof BAKED_SCENE==="undefined"||typeof DecompressionStream==="undefined")return null;
 const data=BAKED_SCENE,bin=atob(data.blob),zip=new Uint8Array(bin.length);
 for(let i=0;i<zip.length;i++)zip[i]=bin.charCodeAt(i);
 const bytes=await new Response(new Blob([zip]).stream().pipeThrough(new DecompressionStream("gzip"))).arrayBuffer();
 if(bytes.byteLength!==data.bytes)throw Error("Incomplete local mesh packet.");
 const offset=data.vertexCount*data.stride;
 return {v:new Uint8Array(bytes,0,offset),i:new Uint32Array(bytes,offset,data.indexCount),ranges:data.ranges};
}
